notes: All 55 trophies are offline single-player; there are no online trophies.
28 trophies are hidden on PlayStation until earned; the spoiler shield hides their names and descriptions until you earn them.
9 hidden trophies have no confirmed unlock method in any published guide as of 20 Nov 2026; their guides say so instead of inventing steps.
Platinum estimates from the guides run roughly 200-300 hours.

roadmap.name: Play the story — and guard the one missable
roadmap.text: Play Chapters 1-4 and the final mission at your leisure; 12 story trophies pop on the way. In Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude the morning after Down to Earth and keep a Chapter 1 save — it is the game's only possibly missable trophy.

roadmap.name: Stranger strands as they appear
roadmap.text: Finish the five character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus three more stranger strands for Strangers & Freaks. One source reports story-progress windows on these chains, so do them as they appear instead of leaving them all to post-game.

roadmap.name: Activities
roadmap.text: Shooting range golds (42), drone races (14), 20 different races, fishing vs Cal, arcade, bowling, hunting for Bret and the melee drive-by — plus one try of each of the 9 activity types.

roadmap.name: Collectibles and counts
roadmap.text: 250 stunts, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 vehicles, 50 challenges, 8 garages and 10 Scooter Bros registrations. The count trackers in this guide keep the running totals.

roadmap.name: Crime and money
roadmap.text: Partner robberies, 5 bank vaults, armored truck, gang operations, Combat Focus, and $250,000 of laundered Marked Bills.

roadmap.name: World and secrets
roadmap.text: Explore all of Leonida, Ocean Beach, the showroom, and the five still-unsolved hidden trophies — methods unconfirmed as of 20 Nov 2026, so no invented steps here.

roadmap.name: Cleanup and platinum
roadmap.text: Work the 100% completion checklist (15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 80 challenges are enough), pop A Long Road, and the platinum follows.
